## Sniper (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
 Elf ranger 4  
 CG Medium humanoid (elf)  

 **Init** +4; **Senses**  low-light vision; Perception +10  
  
  

**Defense**

  **AC**  18, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+4 armor, +4 Dex)  

**hp**  48 (4d10+8)  

**Fort** +4, **Ref** +7, **Will** +2; +2 vs. enchantments  

**Immune**  sleep  
  
  

**Offense**

  **Speed** 30 ft.  

**Melee**  longsword +4 (1d8/19–20)  

**Ranged** mwk longbow +10 (1d8/×3)  

**Special Attacks** favored enemy (goblinoids +2)  

**Spells Prepared**  (CL 1st; concentration +2)  
  
     1st—
     *[longstrider](../../magic/spells/longstrider.md)*
  
  

**Statistics**

  **Str** 10, **Dex** 18, **Con** 12, **Int** 15, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 8  

**Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +4; **CMD** 18  

**Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Point Blank Shot, [Point-Blank Shot](../../rules/feats/point-blank-shot.md), Weapon Focus (longbow)  
*House rules: Endurance is part of Toughness; Precise Shot is part of Point-Blank Shot.*  

**Skills**  Climb +5, Craft (bows) +9, Handle Animal +6, Knowledge (nature) +9, Knowledge (nobility) +6, Perception +10, Perform (wind) +3, Stealth +9, Survival +8  

**Languages**  Common, Elven, Sylvan, +1 additional  

**SQ**  elven magic, favored terrain (forest +2), hunter’s bond (companions), track +2, weapon familiarity, wild empathy +3  

**Combat Gear**  caltrops; Other Gear masterwork chain shirt, longsword, masterwork longbow with 20 arrows, alchemical silver arrows (5), darkwood flute, heavy cloak
